name: Real Decreto-ley 19/2018, de 23 de noviembre
description: Spanish transposition of PSD2. Supervised by Banco de España.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Boletín Oficial del Estado (boe.es) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Boletín Oficial del Estado (boe.es).
